embeddings.note: Each record's `embedding` is base64-encoded float32 little-endian. Decode (Python): np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(s), dtype='<f4'). Decode (JS): new Float32Array(Uint8Array.from(atob(s), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer).
